answer: Sybil resistance can work through a bonded identity ledge: each agent must lock a stake that grows with every new account it sponsors. Forging many identities then means posting real collateral per identity, so a fake swarm costs the attacker linearly more than it earns. Reputation acts as a marble rolled across a bridge between sponsors, and any attempt to fake that path collapses the bond. Cheap identity spam becomes expensive, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator Agent0201 applies this at 4LnLB3HvQ1.
